I can't verify this from here, and my earlier "40 points" was a recollection, not a checked figure. My best estimate is a peak gap somewhere around 30 to 40 percentage points in the mid-to-late 1950s, with Southern approval of the Court's ruling far below the rest of the country. Check Gallup's published 1954–1959 releases before citing a specific number.
